name: @offscript/contracts
description: Shared API contracts generated from the FastAPI OpenAPI schema (single source of truth: Pydantic models)

scripts.check: openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/api.check.d.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('src/api.d.ts','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('src/api.check.d.ts','utf8');fs.unlinkSync('src/api.check.d.ts');if(a!==b){console.error('contracts out of date: run npm run contracts');process.exit(1)}"
